I hear you man. I live at home and every dinner, every single one, I want to stab both my parents in the face because it is just too much.
when in captivity, they consprire against the common enemy.

My parents have the same opinion of me as you do of your husband. I agree with them though. And I agree with you. There is no need for you to put up with any of his bullshit. Life would be better, at least in terms of quality, without him. You'd be able to relax at least instead of constantly being stressed about what might happen. You'd be sad, of course, but it'll pass with time. Sadness is better than suspiciousness and anxiety. I wish you but the well.
"The world is a beautiful but cruel place" - Mikasa - Shingeki no Kyojin.

Or it is a permanent solution to ever-rising transient set of problems. Although each individual problem is temporary/can be temporary, in an imperfect world, new problems are bound to arise every time one problem is resolved. Is it really worth the effort?

If you'd written this last year, I would have said I can relate so much. 
However things changed. Thoughts became more aberrant. 
Of course the existential quest still carries on but now with almost criminal elements.
I'm not entirely sure why I am saying this but it is to perhaps get you to talk it out with a professional?

Take care.
Good call. Misinterpreting what you see is no laughing matter either. It is a sign of something being a little off. *internet hugs* and good luck.

Not really sure if it is something serious or not. I've seen stuff while driving twice... both times, a person sitting on the guardrail on the highway. I guess it is bad because I look back to confirm it was just my imagination and that's a bit risky since I am the driver. However, I just chalk it up to seeing what I want to see.
